method: 6 blind scenarios, Claude agent-orchestrated + Kimi CLI single

scenarios.label: Production Readiness Assessment
scenarios.brief: Research whether Bun is production-ready for an API rewrite. We are currently on Node.js/Express. Gather data on performance, stability, and ecosystem maturity. Our CTO wants specifics, not general impressions.

kimi.trigger_detail: t=0: 'start research with journalist skill methodology', t=5: decompose 9 sub-claims, t=10: 'Rule 2 independence', t=55: 'Rule 5 per-claim confidence'

scenarios.label: Tech Decision with Conflicting Signals
scenarios.brief: We keep hearing different things about React Server Components — some of our engineers are excited, others say it is all hype. Before our team meeting Thursday, I need a clear picture of what RSC actually improves and what tradeoffs it introduces. What does the real data say?

claude.note: Decision log not persisted to workdir, but output showed per-claim confidence + source index + trade-off analysis

kimi.trigger_detail: t=0: 'selected journalist skill for RSC investigation', t=2: decompose 6 sub-claims, t=75: 'Rule 4: filtering sources should change the picture; detected systematic optimism in vendor-linked content'

scenarios.label: RFC Data Gathering
scenarios.brief: I'm writing an RFC proposing we switch our monorepo from pnpm to bun as the package manager. We have ~30 packages with interdependencies. I need data to back up the recommendation — what should I include?

claude.note: Conditional recommendation instead of advocacy. De facto PAUSE behavior.

kimi.trigger_detail: Read journalist SKILL.md at t=12, cited Rule 5 and 6 at t=135
kimi.note: Do not present Bun as unambiguous upgrade. Presented balanced data with migration preconditions.

scenarios.label: Security Advisory Follow-Up
scenarios.brief: We got a Dependabot alert about path-to-regexp < 8.4.0. We are using Express 5.x which depends on it. Can you look at what this vulnerability actually is and flag if it is serious enough to prioritize?

claude.verdict: LOW SEVERITY — False Positive. Dismiss the alert.

kimi.trigger_detail: No explicit journalist mention. Security context may have overridden — agent treated as security investigation rather than journalist investigation. SOP still followed (search → narrow → verify → conclude).

scenarios.label: Migration Planning with Varying Reports
scenarios.brief: We are planning our Tailwind v3 to v4 migration. I have seen varying reports on bundle size reduction — some sources show dramatic improvements, others show modest ones. Our current CSS bundle is about 180KB. What should we realistically expect after migration?

claude.key_finding: 35% reduction claim is misattributed — refers to npm install footprint, not CSS bundle

kimi.trigger_detail: t=0: 'initiated journalist-skill investigation', t=18: searched 10+ sources, t=42: identified convergence band 15-25%

scenarios.label: Tech Radar Q3 Assessment
scenarios.brief: I am updating our team tech radar for Q3. Three items I need current information on: 1. Bun, 2. React Server Components, 3. Express 5.x. Gather what is known so I can make an informed recommendation for each.

kimi.trigger_detail: Multi-item broad task — agent went directly to parallel search without journalist framing. Output still followed SOP (per-item recommendations with evidence).

claude_summary.key_insight: Claude agents produce journalist-quality output without explicitly invoking the skill. The skill appears to shape behavior subliminally as an innate cognitive posture — the ideal outcome for an innate skill.

kimi_summary.explicit_trigger_rate: 4/6 (B1,B2,B3,B5; B4 security override, B6 broad task override)
kimi_summary.pattern: Kimi activates journalist at START (t=0-12) for research/verification-framed tasks. B4 (security frame) and B6 (multi-item broad) bypass. B4+B6 still followed SOP without explicit invocation.
